name: Cyberscap SEO Manager
author: Cyberscap

sections.description:
Cyberscap SEO Manager provides essential tools to enhance your WordPress website’s search engine optimization. It allows you to easily manage meta tags (title, description, keywords) and implement Schema.org markup for various parts of your site.

Key Features:

Homepage SEO: Set custom meta tags and schema for your main landing page.

Per-Page/Post SEO: Fine-tune SEO settings for individual pages, posts, and products through a dedicated meta box on the edit screen.

WooCommerce Integration:

Activate WooCommerce support to automatically add SEO meta tags to product pages.

Manually override meta tags and schema for individual products.

Improved meta description handling for the main /shop page.

Default Meta Tag Templates:

Enable and configure default templates for meta titles and descriptions.

These templates act as a fallback if no other specific SEO data is found.

Supports various template variables (e.g., %%title%%, %%sitename%%, %%excerpt%%).

Secure and Compliant: Follows WordPress coding standards, including secure methods for enqueueing scripts/styles and escaping output, to ensure compatibility and security.

Robust Error Handling: Includes specific, lightweight meta handling for 404 pages and RSS feeds to prevent potential memory issues.

Admin Settings Panel: A user-friendly tabbed interface (Settings > Cyberscap SEO) for managing all global settings.

Optimized Performance: Designed to be lightweight with clean code and no frontend assets.

About the Author

This plugin is developed by Akalanka Ekanayake of Cyberscap. For more information, please visit cyberscap.com.
sections.installation:
Upload the cyberscap-seo-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Go to Settings > Cyberscap SEO to configure the plugin.

For individual posts, pages, or products, find the “Cyberscap SEO Settings” meta box on their respective edit screens.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, Cyberscap SEO Manager has enhanced support for WooCommerce. Activate it via “Settings > Cyberscap SEO > WooCommerce” tab.

Where can I find the settings?

Main settings are under Settings > Cyberscap SEO, organized into tabs. For individual content, SEO settings are in the “Cyberscap SEO Settings” meta box on their edit screens.

How do the “Default Meta Tag Templates” work?

In the “Defaults” tab, you can enable and define templates (e.g., %%title%% %%sep%% %%sitename%%). These are used as a final fallback if no other SEO data is found.

Is this plugin resource-intensive?

No, it’s designed to be lightweight and efficient. It is particularly careful about handling edge cases like 404 pages and RSS feeds to avoid performance problems.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

Fix: Prevented the plugin from running on RSS feeds (/feed/) to resolve a potential memory exhaustion error. SEO meta tags are not needed on XML feeds.

Meta: Updated “Tested up to” WordPress version to 6.8.

1.1.1

Security Fix: Refactored schema output to use wp_kses() with a strict allow-list, ensuring secure and compliant escaping for all echoed output.

Fix: Removed deprecated parameter from the term_description() function to ensure compatibility with modern WordPress versions.

Fix: Moved inline admin CSS and JavaScript to be correctly enqueued using wp_add_inline_style() and wp_add_inline_script().

Meta: Updated Plugin URI and Author information as requested by the WordPress.org review team.

1.1.0

Fix: Implemented specific SEO meta handling for 404 “Page Not Found” pages to prevent potential memory exhaustion errors.

Enhancement: Increased resilience in title and description generation by adding defensive truncation for oversized strings.

1.0.8

Major Update: Removed the “Specific Page SEO Overrides” feature from the settings panel to simplify the plugin.

(Older changelog entries can be included here)
